description: lreview benchmark: merged Lustre changes whose bugs a later commit fixed (its Fixes: trailer names the change), plus controls with no known bug. Each bug has a summary for the LLM judge and regex match sets: a finding matches a set when it matches every pattern in it.

cases.subject: LU-5896 mdt: allow clients with old mdc_swap_layouts

bugs.fix_subject: LU-5896 mdt: do not overwrite the actual buffer size
bugs.summary: swabber_dumper_helper() sets len = rmf_size for every non-array field before calling the field's rmf_swab_len swabber. The new RMF_F_MINIMUM_SIZE field RMF_SWAP_LAYOUTS therefore always reaches lustre_swab_swap_layouts() with the 8-byte minimum, never the real buffer length, so msl_dv1/msl_dv2 of a 24-byte request are never swabbed for an opposite-endian peer.

mdc_ioc_swap_layouts() calls req_capsule_set_size(RMF_SWAP_LAYOUTS, 24) after mdc_prep_elc_req() has already packed the request. set_size does not resize or move packed buffers, so copying the 24-byte struct into the 8-byte RMF_SWAP_LAYOUTS buffer overwrites the start of the following RMF_DLM_REQ (the ELC cancel data).

cases.subject: LU-18878 ptlrpc: improve ping evictor and recovery timeout

bugs.fix_subject: LU-17000 obdclass: handle export timer allocation failure
bugs.summary: obd_export_timed_init() checks the void ** argument instead of the pointer OBD_ALLOC() wrote through it, so it returns 0 even when the allocation failed. Its callers (ptlrpc_update_export_timer(), rev_import_init()) then call obd_export_timed_add() with a NULL node while holding obd_dev_lock and hit LASSERT(ned != NULL) under memory pressure.

cases.notes: Two later commits (0498ab0fd6, 0a5ee1a2a2) also change the timeout formula; they are design changes, not counted.

bugs.fix_subject: LU-20495 lmv: fix use-after-free in qos exclude list
bugs.summary: lmv_qos_exclude() walks lmv_qos_exclude_list without taking lmv_lock, while the qos_exclude_patterns/qos_exclude_prefixes set_param handlers free entries under lmv_lock. A mkdir racing 'lctl set_param qos_exclude_patterns' dereferences a freed entry (use-after-free, client panic).

cases.subject: LU-18986 mgc: client part of new registration protocol

bugs.fix_subject: LU-18986 mgc: fix OOB read registering targets with legacy NIDs
bugs.summary: mgc_target_register() takes the new registration path whenever the MGS export has OBD_CONNECT_MGS_NIDLIST, even when the target has only legacy NIDs and server_lsi2mti() never allocated/filled mti_nidlist (only done for LDD_F_LARGE_NID). It then reads NIDLIST_SIZE() bytes from mti_nidlist: a slab out-of-bounds read.

cases.notes: The fix is on the same LU ticket (LU-18986); a reviewer reading the JIRA ticket could see it. bench report flags that as a leak.

cases.subject: LU-19080 compat: match kernel shrinker protocol

bugs.fix_subject: LU-17000 compat: Fix resource leak in ll_shrinker_alloc
bugs.summary: ll_shrinker_alloc() allocates the ll_shrinker wrapper first and leaks it when shrinker_alloc()/registration fails; it also dereferences the result of kvasprintf_const() without a NULL check and frees it with kfree() instead of kfree_const().

cases.subject: LU-19437 lnet: re-create missed Lustre peers

bugs.fix_subject: LU-19928 ptlrpc: don't sleep inside spinlock
bugs.summary: LNetPeerDiscovered() now calls lnet_peerni_by_nid_locked(), which can take a mutex and sleep, but it is called from import_select_connection() inside a spinlock-protected loop: sleeping in atomic context.

cases.subject: LU-19707 lnet: fix RTNL assert in LNet on v6.15

bugs.fix_subject: LU-20102 o2iblnd: do not call rtnl_lock() in RCU read section
bugs.summary: The change takes rtnl_lock() (a sleeping mutex) inside an RCU read-side critical section; only a reference on the net device should be taken under RCU and the locked work done outside.

bugs.fix_subject: LU-20580 o2iblnd: don't sleep in atomic in kiblnd_startup()
bugs.summary: kiblnd_startup() queries the net device link status (lnet_get_link_status(), which takes rtnl_lock(), a mutex) inside the kib_global_lock write section with interrupts off: sleeping in atomic context, reported as 'scheduling while atomic' and able to stop a node booting when rtnl_mutex is contended.

cases.subject: LU-19030 quota: lfs quota all respects nodemap

bugs.fix_subject: LU-20485 ofd: hold nodemap ref while using the nodemap object
bugs.summary: ofd_quotactl() drops its nodemap reference with nodemap_putref() before lquotactl_slv() has finished using the nodemap, so the nodemap can be freed while still in use.

cases.subject: LU-19095 mgc: notify MGS about LNet changes

bugs.fix_subject: LU-19389 mgc: check reply in mgc_nid_notify_interpret()
bugs.summary: mgc_nid_notify_interpret() reads the reply message without checking rc or that a valid reply exists, so a failed or timed-out RPC dereferences a missing reply.

cases.subject: LU-19014 memcg: fix client hang in balance_dirty_pages()

bugs.fix_subject: LU-20078 osc: call osc_extent_tree_dump() without object lock held
bugs.summary: The new osc_extent_tree_dump() call in osc_cache_writeback_range() (dirty-exceeded path) walks the extent rbtree without osc_object_lock(); next_extent() asserts the extent is still in the tree, so a concurrent removal panics.

cases.notes: A second later fix (39a24e8028, osc shrinker NULL deref) names this change too, but mostly reorders teardown that predates it; not counted.

cases.subject: LU-18812 lnet: restrict IP addresses that socklnd listens on

bugs.fix_subject: LU-20132 lnet: statically initialize acceptor wait queue
bugs.summary: lnet_acceptor_add_socket() installs lnet_acceptor_ready() as the data_ready callback on listening sockets during LND startup, before the acceptor thread initialises the wait queue it wakes (init_waitqueue_head runs in the thread). A connection completing in that window wakes an uninitialised wait queue: NULL dereference in __wake_up_common().

bugs.fix_subject: LU-19528 lnet: restore kernel cb before listener sk free
bugs.summary: The listening socket is released without restoring its original kernel callbacks, so a late data_ready interrupt during teardown calls lnet_acceptor_ready() on freed state and crashes in __wake_up_common().

cases.subject: LU-18155 misc: use LASSERT/F instead of if () LBUG()

bugs.fix_subject: LU-20559 misc: keep updates out of assertion conditions
bugs.summary: Converting 'if (...) LBUG()' to LASSERT/LASSERTF moved state-changing calls into the assertion condition: atomic_dec_and_test() in dt_los_put() and test_and_set_bit()/test_and_clear_bit() on lut_client_bitmap. With --disable-libcfs-assert LASSERT does not evaluate its condition, so the reference is never dropped and the bitmap never updated.

cases.subject: LU-19951 osc: fix kswapd writeback vs writer deadlock
LU-19827 lnet: Fix MR forwarding
cases.notes: Only a later test fix; code and tests mixed.
